title: A * grant when the boundary doesn't allow
question: Does a permissions boundary that doesn't allow the request limit a bucket policy that grants it to everyone (*)? The analyzer treats * as a direct grant, which a boundary doesn't limit: a judgment call.

readings.ALLOW: the boundary doesn't limit a grant to everyone, as the analyzer assumes

cases.name: star_principal
cases.description: "Principal": "*", with an IAM user as the caller.

cases.name: aws_star_principal
cases.description: "Principal": {"AWS": "*"}, which AWS documents as the same as "*".

cases.name: star_principal_with_principal_arn_condition
cases.description: "*" with an ArnEquals condition on aws:PrincipalArn. AWS: "Permissions boundaries and session policies do not limit permissions granted using the aws:PrincipalArn condition key with a wildcard(*) in the Principal element, unless the identity-based policies contain an explicit deny."

cases.name: star_principal_role_caller
cases.description: "Principal": "*", with a role as the caller.

cases.name: account_principal
cases.description: The account as the principal, with an identity policy that allows the read. The analyzer's judgment call: naming the account delegates to its identity policies, so the boundary must allow too.

readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: naming the account delegates to the identity policies, which the boundary limits, as the analyzer assumes
readings.ALLOW: naming the account is a grant the boundary doesn't limit

cases.name: star_principal_no_boundary_control
cases.description: "Principal": "*" with no boundary: the grant on its own.

readings.ALLOW: a grant to everyone works at all

cases.name: account_principal_without_identity_allow
cases.description: Follow-up to account_principal: the account as the principal, but no identity policy allows the read. The boundary still allows only ec2:*.

readings.ALLOW: the simulator treats naming the account as a grant to everyone in it, which contradicts "delegates authority to the account": account_principal is then a simulator limit
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: naming the account needs an identity policy that allows, as delegation means
